title: Shorten the two-axis witness from 16 to six records (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Exact finite certificate: the two-axis witness using 16 records in unpaidmoon's #7286 elimination has a shortest recipe of six. The full 3,072-element affine-quadratic monomial group has directed diameter eight in the same eight-record alphabet, retaining absolute phase and charging inverse S/global-i as three unit records.

```text
six-record witness: C01, X1, C10, S1, omega, omega
complete synthesis: literal actions -> distance table <- polynomial normal forms
```

This answers #7286 Open next question 1 at its requested n=2 first example. The result and attaining words were produced by Nick Petalas. Credit unpaidmoon for that question and witness, intqwq #4610 for the normal form and selected record alphabet, and the retained physical/native/compiler lineage. Finite-group enumeration and shortest-path certification are classical. No predecessor scientific verifier is imported or replayed.

Only `research/two-axis-monomial-geodesics/` is added. The formal-interface-lemma card is explicitly changed to this finite synthesis side result. Canonical base and final upstream checkpoint are `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8; selected #7000 is unchanged.

## Evidence

- Before: the cited synthesis uses 16 records for its n=2 extremizer. After: the displayed word attains its certified minimum six; every group element has an attaining word of length at most eight, with 93 elements requiring eight.
- Both exact implementations cover all 3,072 states and all 24,576 labeled transitions. The primary implementation replays every attaining shortest word. The separate polynomial implementation checks all literal transitions, every edge distance inequality and every decreasing predecessor. The distance histogram is `1,8,42,162,467,884,940,475,93` at distances 0 through 8.
- Canonical distance-table SHA256: `4aec51eef32c395d364567018d10626bc96fe507b0591fa312ef3c3688ce1d4c`. Generated stdout receipts bind every package file. Four endpoint-changing controls, three invalid-certificate controls and three domain controls pass with the documented outcomes.
- CPython 3.12.15 normal and optimized warning-strict checks pass. Each registered command was timed locally: 0.045, 0.047, 0.153 and 0.153 seconds, below its sixty-second timeout. These are checker durations, not a speedup claim.
- Registered replay, source metadata, exact committed-byte/source-history preflight, official export/integrity, and all four scientific commands in a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH pass. The selected source-binding orientation also passes; no selected scientific replay is claimed.

From the worktree root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/two-axis-monomial-geodesics/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/two-axis-monomial-geodesics/independent_check.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-axis-monomial-geodesics
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/two-axis-monomial-geodesics --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 executable can replace that local path. VERIFY.json registers both direct commands with and without `-O`. The README also gives exact external-certificate export/check commands; default verification writes nothing.

## Limitations

The theorem is a finite one-column optimum for two axes, exactly eight directed unit-price records and exact absolute phase. It does not cover extra workspace, different phase prices, a projective quotient, other alphabets or shortestness at other column counts. The displayed identities tensor-lift, but this does not transfer the distance lower bounds. No source-word rewrite is installed. Physical movement/restoration/tape costs, a selected caller and all five inherited assumptions remain outside the claim. No new kappa, supplier admission or complete multiplication theorem follows. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Lean, Docker and the selected cold replay were not run.

## Open next questions

- Pin one contiguous two-axis subword of an actual selected normalizer and test an exact replacement while retaining its complete endpoint, restoration and record prices. No source substitution is supplied here.
- Determine the three-axis directed diameter using a certified reduction or bounded enumeration. The present result gives no all-n diameter formula.

## Related open work

- #7286, unpaidmoon: supplies the sharp length of one n-axis elimination and asks about optimal recipes. This result settles its n=2 witness and full n=2 diameter; the predecessor elimination theorem is cited rather than rechecked.
- #7447, unpaidmoon: prices the distinct full-frame F9 operator-2 transport. This certificate concerns unit elementary-record length and does not recompute or change that physical invoice.
- #7430, CubeJerry: implements the selected binary linear maps on fixed tapes. No source circuit or tape program is changed by this finite synthesis result.

- #7513, petalas: studies tensor fixed-space dimensions and correction ranks of the nine-axis F9 transport from #7447. This certificate studies two-axis elementary-record distances; there is no shared numerical claim.

## CI notes

At unchanged head `7de3d50abf18b67138374e6dc8a42e84cf944992`, [run 43442595153](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43442595153) failed `plan` in [Onboarding helper tests, job 131943735290](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43442595153/job/131943735290). I read the checks once and inspected that job log. It reports 760 tests, exactly one failure and 24 skipped. The exact failing test is:

`test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`

Its line-58 AssertionError says '`make frontier7000-verify`' was not found in the CI verification document. At inherited main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, `certificates/selected-result.json` names `make frontier7000-verify`, while `docs/ci-verification.md` still describes #6030 and `make frontier6030-verify`. Both files are unchanged by this isolated package.

I independently inspected the failed-step logs for rohanarun #7124's [run 42905094314](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314) and petalas #7511's [run 43442114549](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43442114549). Each reports the same sole failing test, the same missing-command assertion, 760 tests and 24 skipped.

**The package `replay` job was skipped. CI did not execute or certify this package.** All local scientific, metadata, committed-byte/source-history and export checks remain as recorded above. No fix, new commit, push, retrigger or job rerun was made; the repository-level repair remains with the maintainers.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. One isolated package; no shared code or selected record changes.

**Blast Radius:** package. The scientific claim is limited to the explicit finite alphabet and certificate.
